scope: SUBTREE ONLY. There is no light page theme. `.light` is applied to the three hero AuthCard subtrees by the hero light switch and nowhere else.
mechanism: A `.light` ancestor class cascade plus custom properties. There are deliberately NO forked `-light` components — base.css ships `.light .x-<base>` rules so the ancestor class alone flips a subtree.
rule: A generator MUST NOT create a `-light` variant of any primitive, component or section. Light appearance is expressed solely as `theme: "light"` on a node whose section declares `supportsLightSubtree: true`.
